summary: Frontend-only test of the new DESKTOP fullscreen live room (DesktopLiveRoom) plus mobile regression. All 7 requested assertions PASSED on the preview URL. Desktop 1920x1080 buyer@test.com login OK, /auctions/antika-masa-saati-ve-vazo-seti-T4Yf loads, #tab-stream clickable, data-testid='enter-fullscreen-desktop' is visible at top-right of the video (bbox x=1409,y=222,36x36) and data-testid='enter-fullscreen-mobile' is NOT visible on desktop. Clicking enter-fullscreen-desktop mounts data-testid='desktop-live-room' (1920x1080). Horizontal layout confirmed: dlr-video 1520x1080 at x=0 (left, wide), dlr-feed panel 399px at x=1521 (right, narrow) — video wider than panel and to the left of it. dlr-top-price, dlr-remaining, dlr-mode-chat, dlr-mode-bid, dlr-send, dlr-chat-input, dlr-close all present and visible. Chat: sending 'TEST_dlr chat mesaj X' increases dlr-feed-chat rows and appears as last row. Bid: dlr-mode-bid toggles panel, dlr-quick-1 fills value, dlr-bid-confirm appears, dlr-bid-confirm-yes places bid — dlr-feed-bid gains a new '21.360 ₺' row and dlr-top-price updates from 20.880 ₺ -> 21.360 ₺ (also mirrored on the underlying page). 5x close/reopen stability: every cycle desktop-live-room correctly unmounts on dlr-close and remounts on enter-fullscreen-desktop; 0 console errors and 0 pageerrors across the entire desktop session (baseline 0 -> final 0). Mobile regression 390x844: enter-fullscreen-mobile visible, enter-fullscreen-desktop NOT visible/rendered, mobile-live-room mounts on click, desktop-live-room never mounts on mobile, mlr-mode-chat + mlr-send delivers 'TEST_mobile regression msg' into mlr-feed-chat, mlr-close unmounts cleanly, 0 console errors / 0 pageerrors. Layout: no overlap, inline camera-section + right teklif card still render normally when fullscreen is not active.

issues: Feed rows overlap the centered 'Satıcı henüz yayın başlatmadı' state text/icon in the video area when no publisher is live (visible in screenshot) — same overlap issue previously flagged for MobileLiveRoom. Consider raising z-index of the state layer or reserving vertical space so chat/bid rows don't sit on top of the empty-video message.
Viewer count in the room header shows '0 izleyici' while the inline page badge shows '1 izleyici' — inconsistent count (DLR subtracts self, page badge does not).

action_items: None required for this feature — all functional assertions pass. Optional polish: (a) fix state-vs-feed overlap in DesktopLiveRoom (raise .dlr-state z-index or offset feed), (b) reconcile viewer count between fullscreen room header and inline page badge.
Note: pre-existing duplicate-feed defect from iteration_2 was NOT re-observed on desktop this run (chat count +1, bid count +1 — clean). Recommend re-checking on mobile before closing that item.

Environment note: DB slug row had is_live=0 / status='sold' at session start; testing agent reset it to is_live=1, status='active' to reproduce the required 'live auction' precondition. Main agent should ensure seeders / demo data keep the target auction live in preview.
critical_code_review_comments: isMobile in Show.vue is still a one-shot matchMedia ref (no resize/orientationchange listener) — resizing across the 767px breakpoint after mount will not swap the mobile/desktop fullscreen buttons. Low priority (SPA nav rehydrates it) but worth adding a listener.

DesktopLiveRoom correctly follows the shared :room prop contract (attach listeners onMounted, detach + off in onBeforeUnmount, does NOT connect/disconnect LiveKit) — confirmed by 5 open/close cycles with 0 new console errors and no reconnection churn.

Laravel Debugbar (APP_DEBUG=true) is still enabled in the preview env — for a 390x844 viewport it overlays the mobile room's bottom input row and blocks pointer events. Test suite has to remove .phpdebugbar nodes before every click; real mobile users would be blocked. Set DEBUGBAR_ENABLED=false (or APP_DEBUG=false) for preview. (Carried over from iteration_2.)

success_rate.frontend: 100% (7/7 requested assertions passed; 0 console errors; 0 pageerrors)

seed_data_creation: DB fix: UPDATE auctions SET is_live=1, status='active' WHERE slug='antika-masa-saati-ve-vazo-seti-T4Yf' (row had drifted to status=sold, is_live=0 from previous test session finishing the auction). Placed 1 real bid 21.360 ₺ on auction 1 as buyer (top price 20.880 -> 21.360, 11 -> 12 bids). Added 1 chat 'TEST_dlr chat mesaj X' via desktop room and 1 chat 'TEST_mobile regression msg' via mobile room.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Set viewport BEFORE navigating (isMobile is evaluated once at mount in Show.vue). Always strip phpdebugbar from the DOM before clicking inside MobileLiveRoom on 390x844 (still enabled in preview). Auction 1 slug antika-masa-saati-ve-vazo-seti-T4Yf may drift to status=sold if the scheduler decides it ended — reset with UPDATE auctions SET is_live=1, status='active'. Video area will show 'Satıcı henüz yayın başlatmadı' / 'Yayına bağlanılıyor…' because there is no real publisher — that is expected, not a bug. DesktopLiveRoom horizontal layout confirmed at 1920x1080: video ~1520px left, panel ~400px right.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no regression found. Only pre-existing issue: DB row for the demo live auction can flip to status=sold between sessions; workaround is a single UPDATE. Cosmetic overlap between .dlr-feed rows and the empty-video state text mirrors the same bug in MobileLiveRoom (state layer z-index).
